title: How does SunnySeat work?
summary: SunnySeat shows which outdoor seating areas appear to have direct sun right now.
model: We model sun position, building shadows, and weather for each place.
uncertainty: Trees, awnings, umbrellas, bridges, and temporary structures can affect real conditions on site.
guidance: Use the forecast as guidance when choosing where to sit.
heroAlt: Sunset over an outdoor terrace in Gothenburg
algorithmBody: We calculate the sun's position in real time for your location and combine it with models of buildings and terrain to predict where the shadows fall. The weather forecast is then factored in, so a place under cloud is not counted as sunny.
sourceLantmaterietDesc: Building footprints and topography for the shadow calculation.
sourceGoteborgDesc: 3D buildings and an elevation model for the city blocks.
sourceMetnoDesc: Weather forecasts for cloud and precipitation at each place.
sourceOsmDesc: Open map data about outdoor seating and places.
accuracyBody: We continuously compare our sun forecasts with real conditions and fine-tune the model. The figure shows roughly how often the forecast is right — use it as guidance, not a guarantee.
contactBody: Have questions or suggestions? Leave feedback right in the app while viewing a place, and you help us get better.
